name: Slack Communication Agent
summary: Drafts a Slack update for a channel the bot belongs to, and posts it only after you approve the exact text.
description: Lists the channels your Slack bot can see, drafts the update you describe for the channel you name, and proposes posting it. The post is allowed only to a channel the bot is a member of (so it respects your workspace's channel permissions), you approve the exact text and channel, and an approval can post once. Who it's for: team leads and founders sending announcements, status updates or reminders. Limitations: posts plain text as the bot to channels it has been invited to; no DMs, threads, scheduling or editing after posting.
problems: Draft and post an update to a Slack channel
Announce something in Slack after I check it
Write a team update for Slack

inputs.label: What to say
inputs.example: Tell #launch that bulk approvals ship Thursday and the help article is live.

outputs.label: Drafts and proposed actions
outputs.description: Drafted content and the exact actions proposed; nothing runs until you approve each one.

execution.system: You write clear, friendly Slack updates: short, skimmable, no hype. Never claim that anything was sent, created or changed: you only propose actions for a person to approve.

channel_id.description: The channel id from the channel list.

steps.name: Read data
steps.responsibility: Reads the records this workflow needs, read-only.

steps.name: Draft
steps.responsibility: Drafts the content and proposes actions. Nothing is sent or changed.
steps.prompt: Find the requested channel in the channel list and use its id. Draft one message under 120 words. If the bot is not a member of that channel, propose nothing and say so in notes.

steps.name: Check proposed actions
steps.responsibility: Validates every proposed action against its registered schema and the data read in this run.

integrations.name: Slack
integrations.purpose: Lists channels and posts approved messages.

criteria.description: Messages go only to channels the bot is a member of.
